pages.title: Bruder John Deere 7R 350 Tractor
pages.description: Bruder John Deere 7R 350 Tractor - detachable front weight, Tow coupling with height-adjustable lifting gear, receiver for front loader, engine bonnet can be opened
pages.ld_description:
Modern agriculture is no longer conceivable without modern tractors. As farmers’ work is not only complex, but also full of challenges, they need the right technology. John Deere 7R series tractors combine a low total weight with high performance. This agile tractor not only speeds up transport, but also moves every farm forward.

This important tractor is new at BRUDER, where it can be found in the agriculture theme world. True to the Bruder motto “Just like the real thing”, the tractor is equipped with many realistic details. The bonnet opens and shows the impressive engine. Doors can be opened and offer the optionally available bworld figures space in a modern cabin. Typical of BRUDER is the excellent controllability and ride comfort due to the installed oscillating axle as well as the steering extension that can be inserted through the sliding roof. The front loader (item no. 03333) can be mounted to increase the playing fun. All trailers from the BRUDER agricultural range can be mounted on this tractor.
